stories.title: North East ISD votes to consolidate three elementary schools, aims to save $4 million annually
stories.summary: The three schools consolidated are Dellview, Oak Grove and Montgomery. The district says the consolidation could save them $4 million a year.

stories.title: Vacant San Antonio home engulfed in flames amid neighborhood safety concerns
stories.summary: A vacant home was engulfed by flames Saturday evening, alarming residents while the fire's cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: SAPD: Man shot by SWAT officers during standoff at far west-side home; woman found dead with gunshot wound inside
stories.summary: San Antonio police chief said officers responded to the home near Moon Light and Horal Drive for reports of a shooting around 2:45 p.m.

stories.title: BCSO looking for missing 23-year-old man last seen Sunday evening
stories.summary: Andrew Francis Cram was last seen at 7 p.m. Sunday night and hasn't been seen since. BCSO did not say where he was last seen.

stories.title: Airport traffic back to normal in San Antonio following Friday's FAA ground stop
stories.summary: Our KENS5 crew found little to no problems at the airport with few flights cancelled throughout the day.

stories.title: Seguin police investigating murder-suicide after disturbance call in Schertz
stories.summary: On Monday, Schertz police announced they are investigating this as a murder-suicide.

stories.title: Pizza and holiday lights? San Antonio Botanical Garden is bringing both together
stories.summary: The class will be offered on select Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

stories.title: San Antonio man found guilty of intoxication manslaughter after fatal I-10 crash, officials say
stories.summary: A Kendall County jury also found Allen Remard Graham Jr., 28, guilty of manslaughter and intoxication assault. The crash happened on Feb. 16, 2025, around 6:30 a.m.

stories.title: Driver killed in crash with Alvin ISD school bus, Texas DPS says | No one on bus hurt
stories.summary: Texas DPS said an SUV driver is dead after a head-on collision with an Alvin ISD school bus.

stories.title: Coach at Garland Police Boxing Gym arrested for alleged sexual assault of a minor, officials say
stories.summary: Officials confirm Santos is no longer associated with the Garland Police Boxing Gym program.

stories.title: Victor Wembanyama wins second Western Conference Player of the Week of season, fifth of career
stories.summary: Wemby averaged 27.5 points, 10.5 rebounds and five blocks in San Antonio's perfect week. The Spurs are also on a 12-game win streak, their longest since 2015-16.

stories.title: Texas maintains three teams in AP Top 25 as Longhorns hold steady at No. 8
stories.summary: Texas college football teams maintain their presence in the AP Top 25, with the Longhorns at No. 8, Texas Tech at No. 11, and Houston at No. 20.
